page.overview:
Who is Libby Hall?

Libby "Liberator" Hall is a non-canon character that made her only appearance in the Mortal Kombat novel. She is presumed to be a Black Dragon member, and she had once worked with Kano.

Their assignment was to kidnap a Bolivian newspaperman who was set to release a story about a local money-laundering scheme in La Paz. When Kano tried to stiff her by splitting the payola 60/40, she attacked him and almost gouged out his only remaining eye.
